# Alazab CI toolchain

Node.js: .node-version (24.19.0). pnpm: root package.json (12.21.0, matching the existing root lockfile). All seven workflows use the shared setup-js composite action. JavaScript GitHub Actions have been upgraded to versions whose manifests declare Node 24.

Backend transition: server/package-lock.json is retained as the migration input until server/pnpm-lock.yaml is generated by pnpm import, reviewed and committed. CI imports it only when the pnpm lock is absent, then installs with --frozen-lockfile. The Validate production readiness backend job publishes server-pnpm-lock for review. After committing that lock, remove the import fallback and retire the legacy lock only after updating other deployment consumers.

The Windows Tauri installer uses pnpm dlx with an exact CLI version. Rust remains a separate toolchain.

Do not suppress ignored dependency builds or use floating dependency installs to make CI green.
